source_text: Si nec aves, similago absque oleo et ture — quia sacrificium peccati est. Luctus non festum. Panis asper paenitentiae.
pass_a_gloss: If not-even birds, fine-flour without oil and incense — because sacrifice of-sin it-is. Mourning not feast. Bread harsh of-penitence.
pass_b_english: If not even birds, then [[fine flour without oil or frankincense, for it is a sin offering >> Bible:Leviticus 5:11]]. Mourning, not festival. The harsh bread of penitence.
